fixes.what: The dossier keeps the occupied colonies as German land 'hatched in the occupier's colour' until 28 June 1919 (keyframe_review/9-14), but books no owner-side occupation_start/occupation_end for any of them: the only occupation events are German occupations of Kenya, Mozambique and Rhodesia. After each contest_end the land falls back to plain German colour.
fixes.why: Schema, ledger type: occupation 'the owner records the same event with the roles reversed'. keyframe_review/9 note: 'the contest events and occupation events carry the wartime changes'. Neighbours book the occupier side: french-africa /ledger/60 occupation_start german-africa 1914/8 (Togo), /61 1915 (Neukamerun), /62 1916/2 (French zone of Kamerun); british-africa /31 1915/7 (Namibia), /32 1916 (Tanganyika minus Kigoma); south-africa /1 1915 (Namibia); belgian-congo /2 1916 (Kigoma), /4 1916/5 (Rwanda-Burundi); british-togoland /3 1914/8 (British zone of Togoland). Dates on the pages: Togoland surrendered 26 August 1914 (German Togoland); Khorab 9 July 1915 (GSWA); 'by 17 June, Burundi and Rwanda were occupied' (EAC); Kamerun campaign ended 10 March 1916.
fixes.fix: Add one occupation_start per occupier at the occupation date and a matching occupation_end at 1919/6 (same counterpart string): french-africa Togo 1914/8; british-togoland the Ghana part of Togoland 1914/8; south-africa Namibia 1915/7 (decide with british-africa which of the two siblings is the occupier: both book it); french-africa the French zone of Kamerun 1916/2-3; british-africa (or british-cameroons once written) Nord-Ouest+Sud-Ouest 1916/2-3; belgian-congo Rwanda+Burundi 1916/5-6 and Kigoma 1916; british-africa Tanganyika minus Kigoma 1916 (progressively; at the latest 1917/11). Neukamerun: either an occupation by french-africa from 1914/1915 ending with the 1916 loss, or keep the 1916 loss and say why french-africa's 1915 occupation and 1919 gain are not mirrored.

fixes.fix: Use the 1919 keyframe's correction (German Africa 1914 minus (German Africa 1911 minus German Africa 1905)) as the dissolve region.

fixes.what: Windhuk is a capital from 1884, but the 1884 keyframe is only 100 km round Lüderitz (Windhoek lies about 680 km inland) and the GSWA page does not support 1884.
fixes.why: GSWA page: infobox 'Capital: Windhuk' with no year; Göring 'established his administration at Otjimbingwe'; the earliest Windhoek date on the page is a school in 1894. Rule 9: capitals inside the state's shapes in those years.
fixes.fix: Start Windhuk no earlier than its founding as seat (about 1891, from a page such as the Windhoek article) with Otjimbingwe before it, or at least start the span at 1885 and say 'unverified'. Likewise Lomé (named capital only in 1895 on the German Togoland page) and Douala/Jaunde (Kamerun infobox gives only 'Capital: Jaunde', no year): mark the spans as unverified in the capital notes.

fixes.what: The 1885 gain of the whole of Tanganyika from 'nobody' includes the 16 km coastal strip that the event's own note says the Sultan of Zanzibar kept; no later event transfers the coast.
fixes.why: GEA page: 'The Sultan was forced to accept the German claims on the mainland outside a 16-kilometre (10 mi)-strip along the coast'; the page names only the 1890 Heligoland-Zanzibar Treaty as the settlement.
fixes.fix: Either say in the note that the coastal strip is drawn German from 1885 for want of a page, or exclude it until 1890 and add a 1890 gain of the coast with counterpart sultanate-of-zanzibar (the pre-1963 sultanate has no dossier yet; the existing sultanate-of-zanzibar.json covers only 1963-1964).
